Straight answers.

What exactly do you do?

We get your business found on Google and Facebook, build the website people land on, and make it easy for them to WhatsApp you. Then we build the tools that keep track of the work once they say yes. Most clients start with one part and add the rest.

What happens on the call?

Fifteen minutes. You see the plan we've put together for your business, the budget that makes sense, and the price. If it's a yes, the setup invoice comes the same day. If not, that's fine.

Do you guarantee enquiries?

No. Nobody honest can. We guarantee the work: a proper setup, every enquiry counted, and a monthly report that shows exactly what happened and what changes next.

How much should I spend on ads?

At least R5,000 a month, paid straight to Google or Facebook. Less than that gives too little data to tell what's working.

What do you do on my Google Business Profile?

We set the right categories and services, write the description, add real job photos and set up your review link. After that it's weekly photos and posts, replies to reviews, and a monthly check of where you show up on the map.

How can a website be ready in 24 hours?

We build one-page sites on a setup we've already tested, so the work is your words and photos, not starting from scratch. The clock starts when we have everything: your logo, photos, services, areas and contact details. Bigger sites with a page per service take longer, and we give you the date upfront.

I already have a website. Do I need a new one?

Usually not. Your ads get their own page built for one offer, and your website stays as it is. If you want the website redone too, that's priced separately.

What is a business system?

Software built around how your business runs: jobs, quotes, stock, vehicles or money on one screen, on your phone. Try the four live demos to see them working.

Who is behind ADA?

ADA is the marketing and systems division of Avalon Capital Group (Pty) Ltd, Reg. 2025/671885/07, based in Pietermaritzburg. Every account has one named lead, from the first message to every report.

Straight answers.

Do we have to change how we work?

No. We build around how work already moves in your business. The only steps that change are the ones that waste time, like asking the WhatsApp group where a van is.

Will my team actually use it?

They will if it's quicker than WhatsApp and a notebook, so that's what we build to. Each person sees only what they need: a driver sees the next drop, the office sees quotes and stock, you see the money.

Does it work on a phone?

Yes. Every screen is built for a phone first, including taking photos on site straight into a job, a delivery or a vehicle.

Who owns the information?

You do. Your data stays yours, and it exports to a spreadsheet whenever you want it.

Can it connect to WhatsApp, email and my accountant?

WhatsApp and email, yes: quotes, reminders and updates go out from inside the system. For your accountant it exports clean spreadsheets. Links to accounting software are scoped on the call.

What does it cost?

It depends on what the system needs to run. We see how you work on the free walkthrough, then agree a fixed price on a call. Once it's agreed, it doesn't move.
